system.description:
Room within or aboard for passengers or cargo, common for vehicles and massive beings.

  • Level 1: 1 person / 200 kg
  • Level 2: 2 people / 500 kg
  • Level 3: 5 people / 1 tonne
  • Level 4: 10 people / 2 tonnes
  • Level 5: 25 people / 5 tonnes
  • Level 6: 50 people / 10 tonnes
  • Level 7: 100 people / 25 tonnes
  • Level 8: 250 people / 50 tonnes
  • Level 9: 500 people / 100 tonnes
  • Level 10: 1,000 people / 200 tonnes
  • Level 11: Double capacity of previous level
